title: Think it. Say it.
voice: Your next great idea shouldn't have to wait for your keyboard. What if your words could simply flow?

title: Meet Reflow.
voice: Meet Reflow. Private, on-device dictation that turns the way you speak into the words you want to write.

title: Hold. Speak. Release.
voice: Hold your shortcut. Speak naturally. Then release. Reflow transcribes your words and inserts them into the app you're already using. Stay with the thought. Keep your flow.

title: Your voice. A little clearer.
voice: Leave the ums, repetitions, and rough edges behind. Choose a light cleanup, or use a local language model to polish grammar and shape longer thoughts into clear paragraphs.

title: One voice. Every context.
voice: Draft an email. Send a quick message. Capture a note. Choose a writing style for the moment, with settings that adapt to the way you work.

title: Make it your language.
voice: Names, technical terms, and the words you use every day. Add your vocabulary to the dictionary, and turn spoken shortcuts into the text you repeat most.

title: More than live dictation.
voice: Already have a recording? Import your audio, transcribe it locally, and export text or subtitles. Give your recordings a useful second life.

title: One less thought to lose.
voice: Keep ideas in Notes. Find past dictations in History. Search, pin, and pick up a thought right where you left it.

title: Your words stay yours.
voice: Speech recognition and cleanup run on your computer. Download your models once, then dictate offline. Your voice deserves a workspace you can trust.

title: Speak freely.
voice: Less friction between thinking and writing. More room for your ideas. Reflow. Speak freely.
